title: Concept: XMLDecoder object deserialization (java)
description: XMLDecoder turns XML elements into object construction and method calls. Attacker-controlled XML is a known code execution route. The remedy is a schema-validated JAXB unmarshaller.
applicability: Java code that decodes XML documents from files, requests, or stored data; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Remote code execution when untrusted XML reaches XMLDecoder; HIGH severity.
